text:
sam_sales: Hey team — AcmeHealth wants to push a POC with CloudObserv but they need a completed SIG/CAIQ + quick risk triage. Can someone run point? They specifically asked about encryption at rest, key ownership, and SOC2 scope.

maria_sec: I pulled their CAIQ draft from the vendor portal. It's incomplete: lots of 'see policy' entries and no KMS owner listed. They claim AES-256 for rest but no attestations.

alex_infosec: Can you paste the CAIQ link? Also we need their data flow diagram and whether customer data can be isolated. If keys are vendor-managed we should require customer KMS or envelope encryption for production. For POC maybe limited data + obfuscation is fine.

vendor-bot: CloudObserv - CAIQ uploaded: https://vendors.redwood.internal/cloudobserv/caiq/2026-03-18 (uploaded by cloudobserv-onboard-bot) :white_check_mark:

kai_devops: Quick note: CloudObserv runs on managed DBs in the vendor's cloud account and uses their KMS. No option for customer KMS in current SaaS tier. They do support tokenized/pseudonymized ingestion via an ingestion sidecar.

sam_sales: @maria_sec @alex_infosec urgent — AcmeHealth will only sign if PHI is restricted. Can we approve a POC with tokenization + contract clause limiting data types? Also pricing Q: Acme wants a dedicated instance for the POC — do we have capacity/offer for rented dedicated infra short-term?

legal_josh: For POC we can add a short-term DPA addendum and restrict data categories. Need subprocessors list and standard indemnity language. Also confirm they have a vuln disclosure program and weekly patch cadence.

alex_infosec: Proposed mitigations: 1) Approve POC with tokenization + redaction pipeline (no raw PHI stored). 2) Require ephemeral API keys scoped to the test dataset. 3) Conditional full-prod approval only after KMS ownership or envelope-encryption proof. I'll draft the conditional checklist.

maria_sec: I'll fill out the missing CAIQ sections for the SIG triage: encryption_at_rest: "AES-256, vendor-managed KMS", key_management: "vendor KMS — no customer KMS option", vuln_program: "we have a reported link". Need someone to reach out to vendor for an explicit statement on SOC2 scope and subprocessor list.

sam_sales: I'll intro CloudObserv acct rep to @maria_sec and @kai_devops now. Next steps checklist: 1) vendor provides subprocessor list + SOC2 scope 2) vendor confirms tokenization pipeline docs 3) legal signs POC DPA addendum 4) infra agrees to dedicated instance feasibility.

kai_devops: FYI — dedicated short-term instances possible but require a month lead for GPU pools. For POC we can do a lightweight isolated tenant + resource quotas. I'll share the runbook.

legal_josh: Thanks. If they can't provide customer KMS we'll include a contractual restriction on PHI and a defined deletion window post-POC.

alex_infosec: I'll attach a short CAIQ patch that maps their ambiguous answers to Red flags and Acceptable Controls. If we see no SOC2 evidence, we do not allow production processing of regulated data. POC is OK with the mitigations above.

maria_sec: Great — I'll compile the response and send the CAIQ updates back to the vendor. Will ping here once they reply. :thumbsup:

sam_sales: Awesome, appreciate it. Will loop in the vendor and AcmeHealth for the kickoff next week. :calendar:
